YYEA (Yung Yau English Ambassadors)
Ms. Sania Bano, our NET
teacher, has inspired and guided
approximately 30 elite English
students each year to plan and
organize engaging activities
for YYC students, fostering a
love for English learning. These
activities include Halloween trick-
or-treating, MBTI personality test
booths, and message boards for Valentine’s Day and Thanksgiving.
At the end of the 2025-2026 school year, a magazine
featuring topics such as book recommendations, social media
lingo, teacher interviews, travel tales and recommendations,
study hacks, alumni updates, and unique hobbies and interests
will be published for the first time.
Speaking of unique hobbies, in
November 2025, YYEA and YYC students interested in exploring
unconventional sports visited a bouldering gym in Quarry Bay for
the first time. During the initial hour, students learned essential
bouldering skills and safety practices. Following that, they had
the opportunity to roam the gym, interviewing English-speaking climbers
about their passion for climbing, their jobs, studies, families, and reasons for
residing in Hong Kong.
Exciting activities are on the horizon for the next 25 years. To that, we say, "YYEA!"

田徑隊代表 4A 鄭煒樂
時間過得飛快，在這短短四年間，我由一個對田徑一竅不通的人，經
過無數日夜的努力，到今天終於取得了一些成績。透過這幾年的比賽，雖
然有輸有贏，但我也從中學會了很多。我明白到，一次輸贏並不代表甚麼，
重要的是一次又一次地超越自己。即使對手比自己強，也只需要與自己比
較，這正是田徑的魅力所在。
剛加入學校田徑隊時，教練、老師和師兄們都十分照顧我，就像家人
一樣。直到現在，我也由一位師弟慢慢成長為一位師兄，開始照顧師弟。
除此之外，我亦是中國香港壘球代表隊的一員。由小學直到現在，壘球一
直像我人生中的導師，教會我許多道理。當你真心熱愛一件事情時，它便會成為支持你的力量，
讓你有勇氣和毅力堅持下去，也在不知不覺間打開你的世界與視野，令人生變得更多姿多彩。
藉此機會，我也祝願學校 25 周年快樂。
￼
